original_description:
Generate incredible videos with state of the art AI. Turn natural-language creative direction into videos for social posts, product stories, cinematic concepts, business promotions, and more.

- Create videos from natural-language prompts; the Infoseek agent will guide you to optimize your prompt and get the best results
- Use up to two images and one video as references
- Supports video editing and extension
- Share or download completed videos through your shared link
- English (EN) is fully supported, but other languages have not been evaluated, so they may work but results can vary
- Use your Infoseek account to access your account, saved videos, music, and more
summary_ja: 文章や参考画像・動画から動画を生成し、編集・延長する。
limitations: 英語以外は評価されておらず結果が変わる可能性がある。参考素材は画像2点・動画1点まで。
実動作・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
